north_1.note: North pit 1 (leftmost from north's perspective, opposite south_6)

north_6.note: North pit 6 (rightmost from north's perspective, opposite south_1)

seeds.note: 48 seeds total: 4 per pit at start. Represented as counter values, not individual components.

library.south_side_empty: south_1 == 0 && south_2 == 0 && south_3 == 0 && south_4 == 0 && south_5 == 0 && south_6 == 0
library.north_side_empty: north_1 == 0 && north_2 == 0 && north_3 == 0 && north_4 == 0 && north_5 == 0 && north_6 == 0
library.south_wins: (south_1 == 0 && south_2 == 0 && south_3 == 0 && south_4 == 0 && south_5 == 0 && south_6 == 0 || north_1 == 0 && north_2 == 0 && north_3 == 0 && north_4 == 0 && north_5 == 0 && north_6 == 0) && south_store > north_store
library.north_wins: (south_1 == 0 && south_2 == 0 && south_3 == 0 && south_4 == 0 && south_5 == 0 && south_6 == 0 || north_1 == 0 && north_2 == 0 && north_3 == 0 && north_4 == 0 && north_5 == 0 && north_6 == 0) && north_store > south_store
library.draw: (south_1 == 0 && south_2 == 0 && south_3 == 0 && south_4 == 0 && south_5 == 0 && south_6 == 0 || north_1 == 0 && north_2 == 0 && north_3 == 0 && north_4 == 0 && north_5 == 0 && north_6 == 0) && south_store == north_store

sow.definition: Pick up all seeds from chosen pit, drop one seed into each subsequent pit counterclockwise, skipping opponent's store.

extra_turn.trigger: last seed lands in current player's store

capture.trigger: last seed lands in an empty pit on current player's side
capture.effect: capture that seed plus all seeds in the opposite pit; place all in current player's store

game_end_sweep.trigger: one side's pits are all empty
game_end_sweep.effect: remaining seeds on the other side go into that side's store
